title: On the Weyl tube formula for nonlocal perimeters
summary: We study the asymptotic behaviour of the nonlocal perimeter of tubular neighbourhoods. For a closed $C^{1,1}$ submanifold of Euclidean space, we show that a suitable rescaling of the nonlocal perimeter of its tube converges to an explicit constant times the Hausdorff measure of the submanifold. The constant is the fractional perimeter of the unit ball in the codimension of the submanifold. For finite point sets, we obtain an exact tube formula in terms of a generalised hypergeometric function.
